judgment_text:
Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying to issue a writ of mandamus, directing the 5th respondent to remove the encroachment made by the 7th respondent in the cart track situated at Melmalayanur Village, Melmalaiyanur Taluk, Villupuram District comprised in S. No. 36/3A based on the representation of the petitioner dated 16-10-2023

The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.M. Subramaniam, J.:— With reference to the relief sought for in the present Writ Petition, the learned Additional Government Pleader would submit that after conducting field inspection and survey, enforcement actions under Section 131 of the Tamil Nadu Panchayats Act has been initiated.

2. In view of the said factum, the respondents are directed to proceed with the enforcement actions by affording opportunity to all the parties and by following the procedures and conclude the same within a period of twelve (12) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

3. With the above direction, this Writ petition is disposed of. No costs.
